title: TDA Developer Portal & Core Monorepo
description: The primary centralized production platform housing Member Profiles, Projects, Problem Bank, Announcements, and Admin Management in one unified Next.js + PostgreSQL codebase.
guidelines: Do not split frontend and backend into separate microservices or isolated repos.
Strictly follow the official Next.js App Router Dashboard course architecture.
Enforce server-side Zod validation on all Server Actions and route handlers.
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Public, Member, Contributor, Mentor, Project Lead, Admin.

tasks.text: Configure Turborepo / pnpm workspace with strict TypeScript and ESLint configs
Implement Prisma schema with User, MemberProfile, Problem, and Project entities
Configure Auth.js v5 with GitHub OAuth provider and role-based session middleware
Build responsive Dashboard, Member Profile CRUD, and Search/Filter pagination

title: Junior Developer Foundation (Stages 1–6)
description: Structured progressive curriculum taking first-year students from terminal fundamentals to merging verified PRs in production.
guidelines: No member touches React before mastering variables, functions, async/await, and DOM events.
Enforce 1 Mentor to 4 Juniors pairing ratio with weekly Friday PR deadlines.
Practice workflow: Issue → Branch → Commit → Push → PR → Review → Revision → Merge.

tasks.text: Stage 1 Milestone: Build CLI Task Manager storing state in JSON via Node.js FS
Stage 2 Milestone: Create personal developer profile using semantic HTML, CSS Grid, and DOM Fetch
Stage 3 Milestone: Build frontend-only Problem Bank mock with client-side filters in React
Stage 6 Milestone: Open first reviewed feature branch PR adhering to conventional commits

title: Curated DSA Problem Bank & Roadmap
description: Curated algorithmic problem set categorized by topic, difficulty, pattern, prerequisites, and editorial notes without infringing platform terms.
guidelines: Do not scrape LeetCode or CodeChef statements; store canonical external links only.
Tag every problem with its core pattern (e.g. 'Two Pointers Inward', 'Topological Sort').
Include estimated completion time and prerequisite topic tree for every problem.

tasks.text: Seed 50 core algorithmic problems spanning 6 fundamental patterns into PostgreSQL
Implement client-side instant search, pattern dropdown, and difficulty filters
Build personal problem completion tracker with local storage & database sync
Add mentor editorial submission and review workflow in admin portal

title: Algorithm Visualization Engine
description: Interactive educational visualization tool demonstrating step-by-step sorting, searching, and graph algorithm state changes.
guidelines: Strict separation: decoupling algorithm computation (generators) from rendering.
Never use Three.js for 2D sorting, tree, or graph visualizations.
Provide Play, Pause, Step Forward, Step Backward, Reset, and Speed Slider controls.

tasks.text: Implement generator-based Bubble Sort yielding comparison and swap telemetry
Implement generator-based Binary Search showing left/mid/right pointer transitions
Build responsive SVG bar stage with distinct idle, comparing, swapping, and sorted states
Add BFS / DFS tree traversal visualization with animated edge highlighting

title: Build-from-Scratch Systems Initiative
description: Deep dive projects where members implement internal protocol mechanisms without relying on high-level frameworks.
guidelines: Do not recreate operating systems or raw cryptography from scratch in production.
Focus on implementing the central mechanism: Sockets, Event Loops, B-Trees, or Lexers.
Advanced projects must have a senior reviewer, written RFC design doc, and unit tests.

tasks.text: Beginner: Build Raw HTTP 1.1 Server handling TCP sockets, headers, and status codes
Intermediate: Implement In-Memory LRU Cache with thread-safe TTL expiration
Intermediate: Build Git Clone supporting blob hashing, tree objects, and commit DAG
Advanced: Build Bytecode Interpreter with Lexer, recursive descent parser, and stack VM

title: Cryptographic Certificate Verification Gateway
description: Official credential issuance pipeline generating tamper-evident PDF certificates backed by cryptographically random UUIDs.
guidelines: Never use sequential IDs like TDA-0012 (trivially guessable); use cryptographically random UUIDs.
Public verification URL must display: Recipient, Event, Issue Date, Skills, and Status (Valid/Revoked).
Embed scan-ready high-contrast QR code pointing directly to verification URL.

tasks.text: Create PDF-Lib template with dynamic student name, event title, and issued date
Generate Ed25519 / UUIDv4 cryptographic hash stored in PostgreSQL Certificate table
Embed dynamic QR code routing to public verification gateway
Build public verification page with status indicator, skill badges, and PDF download

title: Codeforces Sync & CP Leaderboard
description: Official Codeforces REST API integration tracking member ratings, contest history, and problems solved.
guidelines: Cache API results in Redis; never query Codeforces on every individual page render.
Adhere strictly to official Codeforces color tiers (Candidate Master purple, Expert blue, etc.).
Do not treat problems solved on different platforms as directly equivalent.

tasks.text: Implement Codeforces API client fetching user.info and user.status with error retries
Setup scheduled daily cron job to sync member ratings at 04:00 UTC
Implement Redis key-value caching layer with 6-hour TTL to prevent rate limits
Build responsive CP leaderboard with color-coded rank badges and max rating

title: Coding Analytics & Activity Telemetry
description: Aggregated metrics dashboard displaying individual streaks, problem distributions, and team velocity.
guidelines: Do not calculate historical statistics on every page render; pre-aggregate via daily snapshots.
Clearly label automated API data versus manually verified metrics.
Track DailyMemberMetric, ContestResult, and ProblemCompletion.

tasks.text: Build DailyMemberMetric aggregate database schema and migration
Implement Recharts difficulty distribution stacked bar (Easy / Medium / Hard)
Create GitHub commit and PR activity streak heatmap calendar
Build team velocity comparison chart for internal hackathons

title: TDA Engineering Lab Sandboxes
description: Isolated research prototypes exploring WebSockets, Docker containerization, Redis, and Vector AI.
guidelines: Each lab must follow: Problem → Research → Implementation → Testing → Documentation.
Labs must remain in /labs or separate branches; never pollute production Next.js core.
Complete Docker and Redis caching before exploring microservices or RAG.

tasks.text: Lab 01: Build live WebSocket announcement push dashboard prototype
Lab 02: Write multi-stage Dockerfile containerizing Next.js for zero-dependency runs
Lab 03: Implement pgvector semantic search over curated markdown technical notes
Lab 04: Prototype peer-to-peer 1-on-1 code screen-share using STUN/WebRTC

title: Engineering Culture, Git & PR Standards
description: Professional software development workflows ensuring quality code review, automated CI, and clean history.
guidelines: Strict branch naming: feature/*, fix/*, docs/*, test/*.
Every pull request requires: Linked issue, description, UI screenshots, and zero secrets.
Code reviews examine correctness, security, tests, and accessibility—not formatting alone.

tasks.text: Create .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md and ISSUE_TEMPLATE directory
Configure GitHub Actions CI running lint, typecheck, and Vitest suite on every PR
Implement branch protection rules on main requiring 1 senior approval
Draft and publish TDA Engineering Maintainer Handbook for succession handover

title: Technical Knowledge Base & Notes Repo
description: Permanent technical documentation repository maintained in Markdown / MDX covering DSA, web, and system design.
guidelines: Do not build an overly complex custom CMS; keep markdown files version-controlled in Git.
Every document must include: Prerequisites, Objectives, Code Example, Practice Task, and Reviewer.
Categories: DSA, Frontend, Backend, Databases, Git, AI, and Career Roadmaps.

tasks.text: Establish directory structure: knowledge-base/{dsa,frontend,backend,git,ai}
Author 10 core pattern guides with code snippets and visual diagrams
Add peer review stamp and last reviewed metadata to all documents
Integrate full-text client search across all documentation topics

title: Peer Mentorship Cadence & Succession
description: Weekly knowledge transfer loop connecting 2nd-year mentors with 1st-year juniors to guarantee continuous leadership.
guidelines: Ratio: 1 Mentor for 3–5 Juniors; never leave a first-year without an assigned mentor.
Weekly Rhythm: Mon (Issue Selection), Tue-Thu (Development), Fri (PR Open), Sat (Review), Sun (Demo).
Rotate responsibilities so all members touch frontend, backend, database, and documentation.

tasks.text: Assign junior-mentor squads with dedicated GitHub project boards
Run weekly Monday issue planning standups with scoped beginner tasks
Enforce Friday pull request open deadlines with live screen-sharing demos
Conduct Month 11-12 maintainer handover and successor onboarding elections
